title: World Loanword Database
cite_as: Martin Haspelmath and Uri Tadmor (eds.) 2009. World Loanword Database. Leipzig: Max Planck Institute for Evolutionary Anthropology; CLDF dataset v4.2, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21415389. Each vocabulary is cited by its own authors (contributions.csv).
kind_of_work: word-centric loanword database: 41 vocabularies of about 1,000-2,000 words each, with each word's borrowing status and source words, as a CLDF Wordlist with a BorrowingTable
holder: each vocabulary's authors (contributions.csv); Haspelmath and Tadmor as editors
glottolog: The release maps its languages and donor languoids with Glottolog; wety's catalogs read Glottolog 5.3.

curation.language_map: etc/languages.json (from etc/languages.reviewed.json and the catalog bundle)
curation.donor_map: etc/donors.json: the donor languoids of borrowings.csv (listed in checks/cl-4/donor-languoids.csv) to Wiktionary codes, from etc/donors.reviewed.json and the catalog bundle
